title: Patient Specimen Saliva Pooling 3:1 and 2:1
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Select protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Choose the desired pool size (2 samples per pool or 3 samples per pool) and any other parameters required by the Python protocol.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated Python protocol file for the saliva pooling run.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the labware on the robot deck as follows:

substeps.instruction: Place sample racks in deck slots 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, and 10.
Place pool racks in deck slots 2, 5, and 8 (unless overridden in the parameters).
For 3:1 pools, keep row "B" empty on the deck to minimise cross‑contamination.
If more than 45 pools are created, use column 5 of the last sample rack to locate the 46th, 47th, and 48th pools.

steps.title: Load pipettes and consumables
steps.instruction: Install the required hardware and tip racks:

substeps.instruction: Mount two Opentrons P1000‑single channel (GEN2) electronic pipettes on the robot.
Load Opentrons 1000 µL filter tip racks onto the appropriate deck slots.
Load an Opentrons 15 mL Falcon tube rack (15 tube rack) onto the deck.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, perform calibration of all labware and both pipettes:

substeps.instruction: Calibrate each sample rack, pool rack, tip rack, and tube rack.
Use calibration tips as described in the OT App support article.

steps.title: Execute pooling protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App; the robot will aspirate 500 µL from each of up to 96 patient saliva samples and combine them into pools of 2 or 3 samples, creating up to 48 pools (2:1) or up to 32 pools (3:1) as specified.
